evidence.detail: The class extends ClientOverlay and renders one fixed 220x40 top-screen surface containing a bordered horizontal progress bar, centered status text and a secondary right-aligned text field.

The overlay stores an explicit integer percentage y, renders the filled bar width from ceil((y/100.0)*barWidth), initializes visible progress text to '100%', and exposes an independent active boolean E as its visibility predicate.

R201 CombatOverlay suppresses itself while this overlay is active, while R112 WorldCoordinateOverlay increases its vertical offset when this overlay is active, proving this object owns a live top-screen status/progress slot.

The only exact-v308 reverse references outside the base registry and its own state handler are layout interactions from CombatOverlay and WorldCoordinateOverlay; no surviving caller fixes a narrower event or gameplay-domain noun.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the generic active status/progress bar overlay. The original feature/domain noun is intentionally not guessed.

evidence.detail: The class is instantiated only as static field F of StatusProgressOverlay and every selector writes exclusively to the singleton rs/l/e/f.e StatusProgressOverlay state.

Its selector switch 1..6 resets/toggles overlay activation, updates the two bar colors, computes percentage plus 'current / max @yel@(percent%)' text, replaces the centered String, and formats the right-side field as '<img=305><value>'; selector 3 is a no-op.
The class extends the R115 ScriptPacketHandler base and uses its integer/String packet-read helpers, so its state-decoding role is structural even though it has no independent rendering behavior.

The live R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registration table for IDs 1..43 contains no rs/l/e/a/n class and no StatusProgressOverlay.F registration. The handler therefore remains present in exact v308 but is not claimed as a live registered ScriptPacket endpoint.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the overlay's packet-shaped state decoder. 'StateHandler' is used instead of claiming an active ScriptPacket registration that exact v308 does not contain.
